title: Clipy - Clipboard Manager for macOS
description: A free, open-source clipboard manager for macOS. Access your clipboard history and quickly paste frequently used text with snippets.

features.title: Features
items: Extend your clipboard with support for plain text, images, and other formats.
Open the menu with a keyboard shortcut to access your clipboard history whenever you need it.
Save frequently used text as snippets and paste it at any time.

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.description: Clipy is open source. Bug reports, feature requests, and contributions are welcome through {issues} or {pullRequests}.

thanks.title: Special Thanks
thanks.firstParagraph: Thank you to {author} for releasing ClipMenu as open source. Without that code, this remake would not have been possible.
thanks.secondParagraph: Although Clipy currently shares many features with ClipMenu, we aim to keep improving it with features of our own. Thank you for making this possible.

support.title: Support Clipy
support.firstParagraph: Clipy offers all of its features for free, and we have no plans to charge for them.
support.secondParagraph: Donations help us continue developing Clipy. If you'd like to support our work, you can contribute through either of the options below.
